blocks.text: Read the chapter with this setting in view: Second Samuel moves from David's accession and kingdom consolidation through ark and dynasty promise to royal abuse, household violence, rebellion, grief, and a four-part closing appendix. It gives a starting point for following the chapter's own movement. The chapter itself should determine how far the point is taken.
